what: blaze-profile (crates/blaze-profile) is the one profiler (BLAZE_PROFILE=<dir>: per-process parts, Chrome trace.json, phases/functions/passes.tsv; BLAZE_STATS step table) but no v2 code calls it: nothing names blaze_profile, and no member depends on it (the root line stays, unused, flagged by manifest_lint). Wire it in blaze-cargo with `blaze-profile.workspace = true`: the client (crates/blaze-cargo/src/cli.rs `main`) installs it at start and calls `blaze_profile::finish` at the end of a build; the daemon/worker (crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve.rs `main`) records and calls `write_part` after each build it answers; child processes (build scripts, proc macros) inherit VAR. Or, if v2 drops BLAZE_PROFILE, say so (and that setting it must stop blaze with an error, no-fallback) and dedup deletes the crate and its root line. From dedup-dead (one way per job: the job exists, the one implementation is unwired).

history.note: Reassigned from cargo (no live window) to dedup-next3, which works in the same paths (Andrew 05:08: an item whose owner has no live window goes to a live lane within the hour).

v2 keeps BLAZE_PROFILE (harness realbench/rival/bench use it; docs/reports/PERF.md). Root blaze-profile line back; blaze-cargo depends on it. cli.rs main: began()+install() before the serve dispatch, so client and daemon record from start; cargo(): note client step + finish() when on(). serve/job.rs: profile_dir() reads BLAZE_PROFILE from the request env, begin() start()s the recorder (a running daemon starts at the request), Job::profiled; wind_up write_part()s before Said::Finish, or discard()s an unprofiled build (new blaze_profile::discard, tested). Children inherit through the job env (script::inherited). Test: job/tests.rs a_job_is_profiled_when_its_command_line_names_a_directory. (dedup-lexer)
